name: What parts of my interior trim can actually be painted?

mainEntity.name: What parts of my interior trim can actually be painted?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most homeowners ask for trim painting when they want **baseboards, door casings, window trim, crown molding, or doors** to look crisp and finished. For this business’s service area, a good first step is to identify which trim pieces need repainting and whether you want just touch-ups or a full refresh. Clean, smooth trim painting usually depends on preparation as much as the paint itself.
acceptedAnswer.description: Baseboards, door frames, window trim, crown molding, chair rails, and interior doors can all be painted. Start by listing the exact trim pieces you want refreshed so the scope is clear.
